subject.name: Saints Michael, Gabriel and Raphael, Archangels
subject.subtitle: Feast, September 29
subject.blurb: The three archangels named in scripture, kept together since 1969 on the dedication day of St Michael's basilica on the Via Salaria. Michael leads the heavenly host against the dragon, Gabriel announces the Incarnation to Mary, and Raphael travels with Tobias and heals his father's blindness — the warrior, the messenger and the healer.
